summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing of the Portuguese Manufacturing/Production Costing ERP (Fase 2 Orçamentos + Fase 3 Ordens de Fabrico). 12/12 pytest tests pass. Full UI flow validated: create quote -> add line via combobox -> live totals -> accept -> convert to OF -> auto-loaded roteiro -> toggle ops -> pendente -> em_producao (50%) -> concluido (100%). Tipos/Maquinas/Artigos pages render seeded data with correctly computed custo_producao_total (6,51 € and 11,39 €).

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility nit, non-blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to shadcn DialogContent in Tipos/Artigos/Máquinas dialogs to remove a11y warnings.

Minor inconsistency: route is registered at '/personalizacao' but original feature spec text mentioned '/tipos-personalizacao'. The sidebar correctly links to '/personalizacao', so user-facing flow works; no fix required unless aligning paths is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Artigo.custo_maquinas property multiplies tempo_min/60 by 0 (dead code at line 85). It's unused since artigo_custo_total() recomputes correctly using maquinas_cache, but the dead property should be removed to avoid confusion.

POST /api/seed seeds artigos with custo_materiais/custo_mao_obra/custo_overhead chosen so that computed custo_producao_total matches the dashboard 'custo médio' values (6,51 € for DTF Têxtil + 11,39 € for DTF UV; mean = 8,95 €). All math verified correct.
converter_orcamento is idempotent: if of_id already set and the OF exists, returns it. Good.
next_sequence uses MongoDB find_one_and_update with $inc - atomic and safe per year.
All endpoints exclude _id correctly with projection {'_id': 0}.
test_credentials: No auth required (public app, no credentials).
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed is idempotent. It pre-creates 3 máquinas (Impressora DTF UV 20€/h, Prensa Térmica 12€/h, Plotter de Corte 15€/h), 3 tipos (DTF UV, DTF Têxtil, Vinil de Corte) and 2 artigos (DTF UV / DTF Têxtil) each with a 2-step roteiro. Already present at start of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is self-contained (each test creates its own data, then cleans up). Public app, no auth. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (currently https://budgeting-orders.preview.emergentagent.com). Tipos page is on route /personalizacao. Orçamento status select is a native HTML <select> with data-testid='orc-status-select' - use select_option('aceite') not click-text. Orcamento detail testids confirmed: add-line-item, line-artigo-{i}, artigo-search-input, artigo-option-{id}, line-qtd-{i}, line-tipo-{i}, orc-margem-input, orc-subtotal, orc-total, save-orcamento-btn, convert-quote-btn. OF detail testids confirmed: op-check-{opid}, of-progress-label, of-status-badge.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All requested features (quote numbering ORC-YYYY-NNNN, OF numbering OF-YYYY-NNNN, global margin, status transitions, conversion gating by 'aceite', auto-loaded roteiro, status progression on op toggle) work end-to-end.
